text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, super cute, kinda like a chihuahua~
...Have you run into anyone like that on your way?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, haven't seen anyone like that...
Are there any other obvious features?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
She's got golden hair tied up with black scrunchies, dear.
She's also a bit easily frightened, so
I don't think she'd be in any dark places, but...

If I happen to see a horse girl like that,
I should let them know.
As I walked along thinking that—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

My eyes met with a horse girl who has
"golden hair tied with black fluffy scrunchies"—Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Whaddya starin' at, ya punk?!

—She's way too feisty to be considered a chihuahua!
Must definitely be the wrong horse girl!
choice_data_list: (Better back off before I get on her bad side!)

text_block_list.text: —Just as I turned on my heels to leave.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Roar & Espo
text_block_list.text:
(GYAOOOOOON!)
—Hyaaah!?

What echoed out sounded just like a giant monster's roar.
Wondering what on earth happened, I turned around...

Espoir City, who had been completely belligerent just moments ago,
was now slumped on the ground, tightly clutching her ears flat.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh...
So you set off the keychain...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Y-You, Tran!!
That thing you grabbed from the arcade crane!
It made the most insane noise ever, dammit!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? Total trap. Just twisting the tail makes
that monster unleash an absurdly deafening blast.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We only realized it this morning ourselves, dear.
We hurried to warn you right away, Espo-san...
choice_data_list: So the reason you were looking for her was—
So you two were searching for her because—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...I'm so sorry, Espo-san.
That loud noise must have frightened you terribly.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? I wasn't scared at all, okay!?
Loud noises don't bother me one damn bit!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! ...Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Does this one make a freakin' crazy sound too!?
I won this with you guys at the arcade too, didn't I!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, careful there, Espon.
If you squeeze it that hard—

text_block_list.name: Plushie
text_block_list.text: I'm bunny-chan!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAAAH!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuuugh... SHUUUUUT UUUUP!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~...
Nobody's around here, right? Tch...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Bunny.
Uhm, my bad about earlier.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't your fault.
...You're actually pretty cute.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Eh? What's with that adorable conversation?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, my bad! 
I really didn't mean to watch!
I just came to tell you more about the keychain—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
SHUT IT!!
Are you ready for this, Tran?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna deck ya! Send ya flyin'!! Crush ya to pieces!!
I'll wipe your entire memory clean, dammiiiit!

Espoir City hastily shoved bunny-chan into
her bag and sprinted away...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: UWAAAAAAAH!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah, a chain reaction of screams has begun...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, oh my... you two.
There, there, everything is all right. Nothing to be afraid of~.

And so, Espoir City and I were both gently comforted
by Wonder Acute until our emotions calmed down...
